fields.title: Media Studio equipment maintenance
fields.description: Studio bookings pause during the scheduled equipment inspection.

fields.title: AVR equipment checkout guidelines
fields.description: Request wireless microphones from the venue desk before your session. List the equipment on your booking and return it to the cabinet after use.

fields.title: Keep the east walkway clear
fields.description: Campus crews are marking event setup zones beside the east walkway. Keep the marked pedestrian route clear of tables, signs, and event supplies. Regular bookings can continue.

fields.title: Report loose cables before using ComLab 3
fields.description: For the current inspection period, report loose network or power cables at the lab desk. Staff will tag affected workstations. Bookings can proceed with the remaining workstations.

fields.title: AVR projector and audio servicing
fields.description: Technicians will clean the projector filters, check the HDMI inputs, and calibrate the room speakers. Booking requests that overlap the service window are blocked.

fields.title: DLL Grounds drainage inspection
fields.description: Facilities staff will inspect drainage covers and mark any areas that need repair. The grounds are closed to new bookings during the inspection.

fields.title: ComLab 1 image and software update
fields.description: The lab team will install security updates and refresh the workstation image. Save work to your organization drive before the maintenance window.

fields.title: ComLab 2 power outlet testing
fields.description: Facilities staff will test the desk outlets and label the circuits. The lab cannot accept reservations during this work.

fields.title: ComLab 4 workstation inventory
fields.description: The technical team will verify equipment tags and test loaned peripherals. Leave all monitors and adapters at their assigned stations until the inventory is complete.

fields.title: ComLab 5 network maintenance
fields.description: The campus IT team will replace a network switch and test access to the learning portal. The lab is closed to bookings during the work.

fields.title: ComLab 3 workstation cleaning completed
fields.description: The cleaning period has ended. Keyboards and work surfaces were cleaned, and the lab returned to its normal reservation schedule.
